essence: The prescribed oblation in this context is made with palāśa flowers combined with sweet substances.
The practitioner should also perform the oblation that has been declared.
At night, an offering of leftover food remnants should be presented to her.
She is especially to be worshipped among women.
The specified woman is one who is solicited and engaged in erotic enjoyment.
